signals.usability_note: A large street tree blocks much of the view, but the house, front walkway and lawn are visible in the background. The roof is mostly hidden.
signals.notes: A red vehicle is parked at the end of the adjacent driveway on the left, which may belong to a neighboring property. The house has a front porch with a flag and a brick paver walkway, and the view is partly blocked by tree foliage.
